hints.title: Pointer Pace Disparity
hints.text: A fast pointer moving at twice the speed of a slow pointer reaches the end when the slow pointer is at the midpoint.

hints.title: Predecessor Positioning
hints.text: Position slow one step behind the target middle node so that slow.next can be reassigned to slow.next.next.

hints.title: Sentinel Head Node
hints.text: Attach a dummy sentinel node pointing to the head to simplify edge cases where the list has only one or two nodes.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in list
complexity.notes: Using dummy head and fast pointer moving two steps per iteration positions slow right before the middle node.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Two-pass counting traversal works but requires traversing the list twice.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fast and slow pointer technique locates the deletion target in one pass without allocating extra memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle the single node edge case and update pointers cleanly.
